fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat, a Grumman aluminum canoe, which we can wash and polish.
findings: Dull, chalky oxidized finish on the bare aluminum hull bottom and sides
Dirt, leaf debris and water spotting on the interior floor and ribs
Grime and staining around the bow deck plate
Weathered, grimy capacity plate on the stern seat
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Grumman square back canoe. The aluminum hull looks a bit dull and chalky, and there's some dirt and water spotting inside along the floor and ribs. We do pre-sale cleanups and polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
